content: {"episode_id":"ep-05147","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93247, long-term continuous ECG monitoring, was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9, Z86.73). The ordering clinician documented concern that intermittent arrhythmia may be contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion. The monitoring study is required to correlate the patient's symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, and we request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial on the basis of this documented clinical necessity."}
